title: "Deviatoric / Spherical Decomposition"
---

## Decomposing strain

Any strain (or stress) tensor splits into a **volumetric (spherical)** part — pure
isotropic scaling, no shape change — and a **deviatoric** part — pure shape change,
no volume change:

$$
\boldsymbol{\varepsilon} = \underbrace{\varepsilon_v\mathbf{I}}_{\text{spherical}} + \underbrace{(\boldsymbol{\varepsilon}-\varepsilon_v\mathbf{I})}_{\text{deviatoric}}, \qquad \varepsilon_v = \frac{1}{3}\text{tr}(\boldsymbol{\varepsilon})
$$

Drag the sliders below to set $\varepsilon_{11},\varepsilon_{22},\varepsilon_{12}$ and watch
the volumetric part stay square while the deviatoric part distorts at constant area.
